describes: TEMPLATE for the CSV downloaded with the export button of the Claude Console Cost page. The column names below are ASSUMED: the official article confirms the export exists but does not list its columns.

sources.covers: existence of the CSV export on the Usage and Cost pages and its filters (workspace, model, month or day); NOT the column names, NOT the timezone

unverified: every column name (date, model, token_type, cost_usd)
date format and timezone of the date column
provenance.notes: When the real CSV arrives, the importer will refuse it listing the real header (MISSING_COLUMNS). Copy this file, rename the fields to the real header, keep status UNVERIFIED_ASSUMPTION and pass the copy with --mapping. Dates without timezone are rejected unless --declared-timezone is given.

timestamps.note: Unknown: the console does not state the timezone of the exported dates. Pass --declared-timezone after checking the console.
